model.summary: Model favors MIN by 10.2 points (82% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (MIN +4.1), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (MIN +1.8), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (IND +1.5). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 44.4 total points (MIN 27, IND 17). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.6), Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.3), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 0.9). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
